items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries after re-aggravating in Week 11. Coach indicated business-as-usual monitoring; potential GTD or rest vs Titans.
items.why: Reaggravated ankle/foot late vs Giants; ongoing issues since Week 8.
items.implication: Availability uncertain for Week 12; Friday decision likely.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, increased workload for next man up (Chris Rodriguez).

items.text: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled OUT for Week 12 TNF vs Bills, missing third straight game. Rookie Emmett Johnson expected to handle lead role again after strong recent performances.
items.why: Groin strain; short week; team not rushing return after Johnson's production.
items.implication: Walker unavailable TNF; monitor return Week 13+.
items.opportunity: Full lead-back opportunity for backup (Emmett Johnson) in high-profile matchup.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury suffered in Sunday's win vs Vikings. Shanahan: not high ankle, day-to-day; Mac Jones took first-team reps. Availability vs Seahawks in question.
items.why: Ankle rolled up on in Q2; finished game but felt bad Wednesday.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice; Mac Jones ready if needed.
items.opportunity: Potential start for Mac Jones; 49ers skill players volume may shift slightly.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week vs Carolina. Since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC average more PPG among RBs; elite matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR run defense.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share projected in favorable spot.

items.text: Ravens RB Derrick Henry placed back in concussion protocol Wednesday after brief symptoms post-Week 11, but HC expects him to play vs Texans. Limited practice; Justice Hill next up if held out.
items.why: Brief symptoms after TD run head hit; re-entered 'to make sure'.
items.implication: Expected ACTIVE but monitor clearance; floor raised recently with Brissett.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Justice Hill RB2 upside.

items.text: Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/game) in two games with Jacoby Brissett vs prior <6%/1.3. Significantly raises PPR floor.
items.implication: LOVE floor in PPR even if protocol watch; stronger weekly play.

items.text: Puka Nacua (and Terrance Ferguson) out for the season (torn MCL surgery); also serving personal conduct suspension while on IR. Rams WR depth and usage redistribute long-term.
items.why: MCL tear; 4-5 month recovery; surgery completed.
items.implication: No return in 2026 regular season or likely playoffs.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for remaining Rams WRs (e.g. Davante Adams, others).

items.text: Colts cut Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson set to start. Major QB change impacts Indy skill-player efficiency and rushing upside ROS.
items.why: Poor Jones play; team 3-8 decision for best interest.
items.implication: More designed runs/scrambles possible; pass volume/accuracy variance for WRs/TEs (Pittman, Downs, Warren, etc.).
items.opportunity: QB streaming/athletic upside; skill players adjust to AR style.

items.text: HATE Bo Nix this week; outside top 20. Expecting heavy Jonah Coleman (RB) usage vs Pittsburgh and insufficient Nix rushing production to compensate.
items.why: Game script/run-heavy lean; limited dual-threat upside seen.

items.text: On Travis Etienne: expect disappointing snaps/routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count. Solid playoff schedule (ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17). Floor via volume, ceiling capped by pass-game role.
items.implication: RB2/flex with rushing floor; not full every-down back.
items.opportunity: Carry volume + playoff matchups; caution on routes/targets.

items.text: Since Rico Dowdle return Week 6, Jaylen Warren only 51% of Steelers rush attempts and <10% target share in 3/5 games. Now mid-to-low RB2, not fringe RB1.
items.why: Split with Dowdle reducing carries and targets.
items.implication: Lower weekly floor/ceiling; flex rather than locked starter.

items.text: With Kyle Monangai back, D'Andre Swift 47% snaps / 39% rush attempts in Week 11 and <10% targets in 4/5 Monangai-active games. Mid-to-low RB2 now.
items.why: Committee return of Monangai cutting into role.
items.implication: Downgrade from prior RB1 looks; volatile flex.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11 vs Steelers (season avg 36%); 50% of Eagles end-zone targets. Role elite when healthy despite prior injury drag.
items.why: Massive target concentration in recent game.
items.implication: WR1 upside if volume sustains; ride-or-die validation.

items.text: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share in return (20.7 FP). When >=20% share, averages 17.5 PPG. Health is the IF for sustained solid WR option.
items.why: Strong target share on limited snaps post-return.
